description: Limits for the rig gate in launchclip finish (src/rig_gate.js) on scenes drawn by the per-frame rig (content.rigScene), measured by kit/core/characters/rig-metrics.mjs at the story's fps in canvas px. errors fail the gate: any joint or prop position that is not a number, a bone that changes length by more than bone_drift_px, a planted foot whose ground contact moves more than foot_slide_px during one step, a hand more than grip_loss_px from a prop when it takes or lets go of it, and an unheld prop that moves more than prop_teleport_px in one frame. warnings are guides calibrated on the approved prototype (docs/rd/per-frame-rig.md §4: jerk per unit of motion 665/s² against 1088 for the op-list rig, 6 hand corners in 8 s, limbs crossing in 9% of frames side-on): jerk_per_motion (1/s²), hand_corners_per_s (turns over 45 degrees in a frame, per scene second), limb_cross_share (share of frames with an arm crossing a limb, or legs crossing while the hips are apart).
